name: LogProstyle Inc. Common Shares
summary: LogProstyle Inc. is a Japan-based enterprise whose primary focus lies in the property sector. Its offerings encompass property design, refurbishment, and resale. Additionally, the firm undertakes the development of residential condominium complexes. Their portfolio further extends to operating traditional Japanese inns, known as ryokans, across prominent locations such as Tokyo, Yokohama, and Okinawa, and managing various dining establishments.
